verses.text: A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.

segments.text: A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.

verses.text: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.

segments.text: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.

verses.text: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.

segments.text: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.

verses.text: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.

segments.text: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.

verses.text: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.

segments.text: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.

verses.text: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.

segments.text: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.

verses.text: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

segments.text: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

verses.text: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.

segments.text: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.

verses.text: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.

segments.text: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.

verses.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

segments.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
